question: You are building a Microsoft Fabric lakehouse for financial reporting. The solution must enforce row-level security and provide reusable business definitions across reports. Which two actions should you take? (Choose two.)

options.text: Define row-level security roles in the semantic model and map users or groups to the roles.
Duplicate each report per department and hardcode department filters in visuals.
Create shared DAX measures in the semantic model for consistent KPI logic.
Store KPI definitions only in personal bookmarks to simplify governance.
Disable semantic model endorsements to avoid central ownership bottlenecks.
